reviewScope: Read-only static source review after first R3 implementation; no browser, pixel, Game, user save, compatibility or performance execution. No code/test/Git edits.

findings.problem: The rows watcher clamps page but retains a pick that may have shifted to another page after legal same-life realm progression. The right object can remain selected while no selected slot is in the shown directory.
findings.example: At qi with future=false/all, order is herb,dew,core,healing_pill,spirit_pill,foundation_pill; choose healing_pill at index3/page0. After foundation, jade is inserted at index3, moving healing_pill to index4/page1. watch(rows) sees item still present and retains page0.
findings.effect: Real amount and Game are safe, but object/source relationship and clear selected-state contract become inconsistent after returning from breakthrough.
findings.recommendation: When data-driven rows change, retain a valid pick and set page to its index/4; if invalid, choose a valid object on clamped page. Preserve explicit user paging/filter behavior. Add lawful same-life realm progression-return test (not import new life only).

findings.problem: The cached learning component does not reconcile rows when same-life school changes. With filter=current, a previous sword selected id is absent after explicitly changing to talisman; skill computes null, yet rows contain current talisman entries. locate watches highlight only and is not called for school change.
findings.example: Open sword skills (current filter), visit 修法 and confirm talisman, then return 功法. Equipment/Learning KeepAlive preserves selected=sword_mind; unchanged empty highlight does not rerun locate. Current rows are talisman basics, skill null, so centre says 当前无此类经卷 until manually choosing another object.
findings.effect: No unauthorized write, but false empty state after a normal meaningful choice contradicts selected current-object clarity and makes equipment flow appear broken.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile selected object and directory page on data-driven rows change, preserving queue/budget and mode drafts. Add lawful same-life SCHOOL confirmation -> skills return test, with real new Game but no subsequent mutation on selection.
